# apple_game_center_activity_leaderboard (Resource)

Links a Game Center activity to a leaderboard of the same app or group, which players then see with the activity. Import it with `<activity_id>/<leaderboard_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_game_center_activity_leaderboard" "example" {
  activity_id    = apple_game_center_activity.example.id
  leaderboard_id = apple_game_center_leaderboard.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `activity_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the activity, e.g. `apple_game_center_activity.example.id`.
- `leaderboard_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the leaderboard, e.g. `apple_game_center_leaderboard.example.id`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_game_center_activity_leaderboard.example
  identity = {
    activity_id    = "1d3f5a7c-9b2e-4c6d-8a0f-2b4c6d8e0f1a"
    leaderboard_id = "9c1e3a5b-7d2f-4b6a-8c0e-5f7a9b1c3d4e"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `activity_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the activity.
- `leaderboard_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the leaderboard.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_game_center_activity_leaderboard.example 1d3f5a7c-9b2e-4c6d-8a0f-2b4c6d8e0f1a/9c1e3a5b-7d2f-4b6a-8c0e-5f7a9b1c3d4e
```
